messages:
zoe_fin: FYI: nightly AR reconciliation flagged a $4,800 shortfall vs Stripe for yesterday's refunds batch. Stripe shows refunds succeeded but NetSuite has fewer refund credit memos. anyone seen glue/connector errors overnight?

mike_eng: interesting. I pulled connector logs and saw a sequence gap between 02:54-03:06 UTC for the refund processor. there were a bunch of HTTP 5xx responses from the netsuite API and the connector's retry logic dropped some callbacks when the retry queue hit size cap.

sara_ops: build-bot alerted about worker restarts in that window: build-bot: worker-refund-processor crashed x4 due to OOM, restarted by supervisor. logs show queue trimming kicked in to keep memory under threshold which may have inadvertently removed in-flight webhook items.

kevin_fs: practical impact: 18 refunds (~$4,800) never created NS credit memos. Collections already picked up two of those accounts. Finance needs approval to apply a temporary manual credit for affected customers and mark as "refund in-flight" in notes to avoid double-apply.

mike_eng: root cause hypothesis: retry queue had a LRU trim policy that wasn't durable across restarts. when the worker OOMed the in-memory queue lost the oldest retry entries — which happened to be refund events. Also our webhook ack happened before durable persistence for speed.

zoe_fin: ok. can we get an export of the missing Stripe refund ids + customer IDs? we will reconcile and schedule manual credits. also want a short runbook so collections knows to pause dunning for impacted accounts.

sara_ops: working on CSV now. will include stripe_refund_id, stripe_charge_id, customer_email, amount, timezone. dumping to /shared/finance/refund-incident/2266001234-missing-refunds.csv in ~20m.

mike_eng: short-term mitigations: 1) set connector to persist retries to durable store (feature flag) 2) disable aggressive in-memory trimming 3) add a startup recovery pass that replays unacknowledged webhook entries from durable queue. deploying the feature-flag change to prod in the next 2 hours.

kevin_fs: ops approval: manual credits up to $6k approved to clear customer-facing issues. please include audit note referencing this thread and the CSV. cc finance-ops. :white_check_mark:

build-bot: Deployment started: refund-retry-durable-flag -> prod (#deploy-789). ETA 12m.

mike_eng: sample webhook snippet we used to identify id field for dedupe and durable key:

```json
{
  "id": "evt_rF123refund",
  "type": "charge.refunded",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "re_1Example",
      "amount": 2700,
      "refunds": { "data": [ { "id": "rf_1Example" } ] },
      "customer": "cus_ABC123"
    }
  },
  "created": 1700000000
}
```

mike_eng: plan for backfill: once durable retries are enabled we'll run a dry-run that attempts to create missing credit memos in Netsuite but logs changes to a staging table. finance will vet the staging table before we flip to actual apply.

zoe_fin: please add a prepend note in the CSV with the collection hold instructions. also ping when deploy completes and when the CSV is uploaded.

sara_ops: CSV uploaded: /shared/finance/refund-incident/2266001234-missing-refunds.csv. flagged accounts in the collections dashboard and paused dunning for those customer_ids.

mike_eng: deploy finished. recovery worker started a replay scan and found 21 candidates; 18 matched stripe refunds not present in NS. starting dry-run backfill now.

zoe_fin: thanks. will review dry-run output and confirm authorize apply. keep this thread for updates only. short messages please.
